_comment: Shared mwccarm codegen lever catalogue. One lever per line; read it with tools/levers.py, not by hand-parsing. This is a DISTILLED INDEX, not the evidence - `source` points into the narrative notes where each was actually derived, and those notes stay the record. Other decomps in this family read this file across a sibling checkout (see tools/levers.py --repo). Fields: arch = ISAs the mechanism is known or believed to work on; thumb = proven|untested|inapplicable, and it is `untested` for almost everything because this catalogue was derived on an all-ARM title; confidence = proven (reproduced a ROM byte-match) or probable.

symptom: a store or call sits in the wrong arm of an if/else, or the then/else bodies are swapped relative to the target
lever: move the store or call into or out of an arm; swap then/else by inverting the condition

symptom: the loop tests at the wrong end (top vs bottom), or a find-first loop has the wrong exit shape
lever: while() vs do/while flips top vs bottom test; for(;;) with break for find-first loops

symptom: returns branch to separate epilogues where the target shares one exit, or the reverse
lever: merge separate `if(x) return K` into one && chain to a shared exit, or split a && chain into guard clauses; write new-ctor null checks as `if(p){body} return p`

symptom: the target computes the same value by a different instruction (e.g. smulbb by -1 where you emit rsb #0)
lever: x/K vs (x*magic)>>s, x%K vs x-(x/K)*K, negative const via mov+rsb, -1 via mvn. The div/modulo half is source-level and should carry to Thumb; the mov+rsb / mvn half names ARM mnemonics

symptom: wrong load instruction: ldr where the target has ldrb/ldrsb/ldrh/ldrsh, or wrong signedness
lever: change the local's type or add a cast: u8/s8/u16/s16 flips which load is emitted. Thumb has the same four load widths, so the mechanism should carry

symptom: push set or frame layout is off by a register
lever: mwccarm allocates in DECLARATION ORDER - reorder the top-of-block C89 declarations. Also: reuse a var, or re-emit a global/field inline instead of hoisting it into a local. Thumb caveat: the push set itself is constrained differently (r0-r7 plus lr), so the symptom may not present the same way

symptom: target uses predicated moves (movne/moveq) where you emit a branch, or a value lands in the wrong register
lever: change the access expression - `*(T*)&G` vs `G[0]` - or materialize a bool (`int b=(x==k); if(b)`) to steer toward movne/moveq. INAPPLICABLE on Thumb: classic Thumb has no conditional execution, so there is no predicated-move shape to steer toward

symptom: target batches a two-word copy as ld,ld,st,st where you emit ld,st,ld,st
lever: use int temps plus a fake dependency: `dst_a = b ? a : a;`

symptom: target has `add rX, base, #imm` then `[rX]`, where your C folds the offset into `[base, #imm]`
lever: the u64-mask laundering idiom: `*(int *)(((int)base + 0xOFF) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)`. The identity AND blocks offset folding and forces the add. Cast to (int) BEFORE adding the offset, then mask. Vary the inner cast type to launder distinct macros

symptom: your loop index gets strength-reduced into a pointer induction variable while the ROM re-derives base + i each iteration
lever: `#pragma opt_strength_reduction off` above the function. Optimizer-level rather than ISA-level, so it should carry to Thumb. pictochat used exactly this to fix FUN_022ce5b4 after four natural loop rewrites all failed

symptom: target DUPLICATES an early-exit epilogue (popeq/bxeq repeated) where you branch to a shared tail
lever: `#pragma optimize_for_size on`

symptom: a constant gets folded away where the target recomputes it, and u64-mask laundering is inert because the operands are pure constants
lever: `#pragma opt_propagation off`

symptom: stack slots the target keeps are optimized away in your build
lever: a volatile local, or a volatile struct field access, keeps them live. mwccarm syntax note: `volatile` must precede the type

symptom: halfword or byte access at offset >= 0x100 against a materialized base
lever: plain `*(short*)(p+0x100) = k` reproduces it - no laundering needed. INAPPLICABLE as written on Thumb: the 0x100 threshold comes from ARM's immediate-offset encoding range, and Thumb's differs, so the cutoff is not the same number

symptom: a spurious lsl #0x10 / lsr #0x10 truncation pair wraps an `and` where the ROM emits one plain `and`
lever: widen the masking variable's storage type to plain `int` (NOT `unsigned int` - that measured worse), keeping the same expression and adding explicit narrowing casts back at each USE site: `entry[3] = (unsigned short)(entry[3] & mask)` rather than `entry[3] &= mask`. Ruled out first: unsigned int, operand-order swap, a separate named intermediate, explicit cast chains

symptom: the same cmp-style instruction appears TWICE in quick succession in the target against what should be one boolean, while you emit one shared compare and branch
lever: split the C into two back-to-back independently-conditioned if/else blocks, each re-testing the same boolean expression fresh rather than sharing a cached branch. Suspect this before concluding CSE elimination is unreachable

symptom: pure register-permutation residue (often a global 2-reg rename of the args) in a function that dispatches through a C-cast function-pointer table (vtbl[K/4](...)); every coloring lever, pragma, and type respelling is inert on the swap
lever: respell the dispatch as a real C++ virtual call through a dummy-virtuals struct (K/4 dummies, then the method). The C fn-ptr cast perturbs callee-saved homing rank away from the natural reverse-arg order; virtual dispatch restores it. Check before grinding coloring levers, and drop any byte-costing liveness hack the draft used to compensate

symptom: a prologue or first basic block consumes a just-computed address register directly where the ROM reloads it from its stack home, and every statement reordering of the region is byte-neutral; often paired with two of three field reads sharing one reloaded pointer in the ROM
lever: spell the reads through a per-site cv-qualifier cast, ((const T *)p)->x against a const volatile T * declaration, and place them before the region's other declarations. The cast is its own CSE class so it never joins the canonicalised IR that statement reordering cannot escape. Sweep which sites get the cast; at least two of three was the win condition on the proving function

symptom: a single commutative add has operands swapped vs the ROM, and flipping the source terms swaps the two operand LOADS instead; every laundering collapses back to the same two byte-streams
lever: mwccarm emits a two-leaf sum right-load-first and always add rd,LEFT,RIGHT, so ROM order is unreachable while both leaves are loads. Name the term whose load the ROM does NOT re-issue at the site (s32 e = ...; directly before the use) so it becomes a register leaf and the add commutes

symptom: the last mismatches are one slot pair exchanged between a chain slot and a pool slot; second definitions, declaration sweeps, register/const/initializer forms, SROA, helpers, and every allocation pragma leave the variable chained or shift a whole pool band by 4
lever: x = (T)(volatile T)x; after the real definition. Emits zero code (casting a prvalue to a cv-qualified scalar discards the qualifier) but marks the value volatile in the front end and demotes the local into the pool's coalesced band at its source-position slot. The FLAVOUR of a free second definition picks the destination: +k0 folds and forgets, *k1 demotes only to the annex after the chain, only the volatile round-trip reaches the band. Flag it as a matching hack; the author's true spelling is separate work
